title: Verification artifacts for a georeferenced map series: AMS L7014 lattice, mosaic geometry, seam census and datum-correction dry run
description:
Derived geometry and verification outputs supporting the preprint Blind by construction: verifying a georeferenced map series when the check shares the error.

The deposit contains the L7014 survey lattice (627 cells), the source sheet manifest, mosaic footprint geometry from a controlled A/B pair of warp runs (faulty and datum-corrected, each with and without hand-georeferenced sheets), the raw seam tables behind the seam census, the per-sheet datum split, cached annotation control points, and the regeneration record with its logs and environment capture. SHA256SUMS verifies every file from the package root.

Scope. The input GeoPDFs, JPG scans and generated COGs are not included. They remain under their holding institutions' terms and are referenced by path and provenance in regen/REGEN.md. Only derived geometry, verification tables and provenance are redistributed here, under CC BY 4.0.

Two cohorts, not one denominator. The mosaic-only run yields 717 PDF/PDF seams; the hand-extended run adds 36 JPG/PDF and 25 JPG/JPG seams for 778 total and includes the mosaic cohort. A JPG/PDF join is partly committed by construction, because the hand workflow writes the lattice cell as the ground half of its control points, so it is not a free seam. Report the cohorts separately.

Status of the correction. The datum correction is a validated dry run, not an applied rebuild. The served archive at the time of deposit is the faulty pass. regen/REGEN.md states which outputs describe the current layer and which describe the proposed rebuild.
notes: Regenerated from commit 7ee5d947303bdc9183ae8fffc2290bd88ea861ec plus the two source changes recorded in regen/REGEN.md, both since committed at 0aa04f0b. Reproduction entry point: regen/REGEN.md; scripts: scripts/l7014_mosaic.py, scripts/l7014_hand.py, scripts/l7014_seams.py.
